subject: Drop-in HQ demo — timing, NDA & visitor process
messages:
From: Sylvia Park <sylvia@orbitalai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick HQ drop-in next week?

Hi Ben —

We have a small delegation (3 people: me, our infra lead, and product lead) traveling to the Bay Area next Tuesday and wondered if Redwood has a short window for a drop-in demo at HQ. We're not looking for a full day — 60 minutes to see the latest routing/fallback flow and ask a few questions about private deployments.

Couple of quick asks:
- Do you require an NDA or visit form filled in advance?
- Any restrictions on laptops or equipment?
- Where should guests park / check in on arrival?

If Tuesday isn't possible we can be flexible Wed/Thu afternoon.

Thanks —
Sylvia Park
Head of Product Partnerships, Orbital AI
Sylvia@orbitalai.com

Attachment: Orbital_Visitor_List.csv (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Park <sylvia@orbitalai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick HQ drop-in next week?

Sylvia — great to hear you'll be in town. We can definitely accommodate a 60-minute drop-in. Options on our side:

- Tue 11:00–12:00 PT (short walk-through + Q&A)
- Wed 14:00–15:00 PT (more flexible for deeper infra questions)

We do ask external visitors to sign a short one-page NDA before accessing sensitive demo environments; I attached a standard one for Orbital to review. Also included a brief visitor form for names and badge printing. No heavy equipment restrictions — laptops OK but anything requiring network access should be coordinated with our IT team.

I'll loop in Hannah (facilities) to confirm parking and check-in flow; Marissa, can you confirm whether we should lock the demo to the executive suite or main lab?

DocuSign link to NDA (embedded): https://docusign.example.com/embedded/ABC123
Attachments: Orbital_NDA.pdf, Visitor_Form_Orbital.pdf

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Sylvia Park <sylvia@orbitalai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick HQ drop-in next week?

Thanks Ben — 11:00 on Tuesday works best for our group. We'll get the NDA signed this morning. A couple of clarifications after reviewing the visitor form:

- We'll bring two company laptops and one demo appliance (battery-powered). Lt. Ops wants to know if the appliance can be on-site for up to 90 minutes; it's not networked by default.
- Can you confirm whether parking is validated or if there's a visitor lot?

On the attendee list: Sylvia Park (me), Marco Ruiz (infrastructure), Priya Chandrasekhar (product). I'll upload a final badge list after the DocuSign step.

Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick HQ drop-in next week?

Great — locking Tue 11:00–12:00 PT for Orbital (Sylvia, Marco, Priya).

Hannah — can facilities confirm:
- Executive Lab (Room 3B) vs. Main Demo Suite availability for a 60-min slot? Executive Lab gives a quieter environment for infra talk but has stricter access (escort required).
- Visitor parking: we can validate one visitor spot in the front lot and provide overflow nearby (1.2-mile walk) — is validation still free?
- Badging: we need printed badges for three guests, please advise pickup location and earliest arrival time.

Marissa — flagging to you that Orbital will request a short, non-prod walkthrough of our routing feature; please confirm whether we should run a local demo vs. live tenant on Redwood Dedicated.

I've pasted Sylvia's badge list below and attached the signed NDA when it completes. DocuSign link: https://docusign.example.com/embedded/ABC123

—
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Visitor_Form_Orbital.pdf (filled stub)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sylvia Park <sylvia@orbitalai.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 14:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick HQ drop-in next week? — Room & badge confirmed

Thanks Ben — confirmed details below.

- Room: Executive Lab (Room 3B) reserved Tue 11:00–12:15 PT. Escort required; I'll be the escort unless another PM wants to join.
- Parking: We'll validate one front lot pass (guest parking code: RED-OR-45). If they arrive earlier than 10:45, the overflow lot is nearby (we'll provide directions).
- Badges & pickup: Printed badges will be at the Reception Desk under "Orbital AI". Guests should check in 15 minutes before start for badge pickup and a short safety briefing.
- Equipment: The demo appliance can be on-site for 90 minutes; standard policy is no network connection without IT approval. If they need temporary network access, loop IT_ops@redwood.com at least 48 hours prior.

I've created the calendar event and shared it: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-orbital-demo-20280316

Looking forward — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Facilities & Operations | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
